name: The Winston Hotel
description: The Winston is a hotel venue in Winston Hills, Sydney, featuring CALA (a modern Australian bistro), Taffy's Sports Bar, a beer garden, a bottle shop, and eight event/function spaces, all under one roof.

address.full_address: 170 Caroline Chisholm Drive, Winston Hills NSW 2153, Australia

general.notes: Open 7 days a week. An older listing on the Taffy's page shows slightly different hours (Mon-Wed 10am-12am, Thu 10am-3am, Fri-Sat 10am-3am, Sun 10am-10pm); the hours above, from the homepage and FAQ page, are the current primary listing.

hours.kitchen_note: Kitchen/food service hours may differ slightly from bar trading hours; an older reference lists food service Mon-Thu 11:30am-9:30pm, Fri-Sat 11:30am-10pm, Sun 11:30am-9pm. Confirm exact current kitchen close times with the venue.

parking_and_transport.parking: Yes, free on-site parking in front of the venue.
parking_and_transport.public_transport: Bus stops within a short walk. Closest train stations are Parramatta and Seven Hills, both about 10 minutes away by car.

booking_policy.reservations_required_note: Bookings are recommended to avoid disappointment; for Friday and Saturday nights, bookings are strongly recommended as the venue books out. Walk-ins are welcome on other days and staff will find you a table.
booking_policy.large_groups: Groups of 20 or more should enquire via the Functions enquiry form so the room can be set up properly; smaller groups can book normally.
booking_policy.cancellation_policy: Table bookings can be cancelled up to 2 hours in advance via the confirmation email.

venues.name: CALA Bistro
venues.description: The Winston's bistro. Modern Australian, made for sharing. Shared plates, wood-fired pizza, steak off the grill, and a tight but considered wine list.

venues.name: Taffy's Sports Bar
venues.description: The Winston's sports bar - full of character, loud, and set up for match day. Huge screens plus booths with personal screens for watching your own game. Wood-fired pizzas are noted as the perfect food for sport.
venues.menu_description: Pub classics done properly. Schnitty, burgers, loaded fries, parma that's earned its name. Built for match day and long afternoons.

venues.name: Beer Garden
venues.description: Sunshine, schooners, and long lunches. Pet-friendly, kid-friendly, and Sunday-session-friendly.

venues.name: Function & Event Spaces
venues.description: Eight distinct spaces with capacity for functions ranging from 10 to 150 guests. Space hire is free of charge, with a minimum spend on food and beverages required instead.
venues.pricing_model: Free venue hire; minimum spend on food & beverage required
features: Natural light and open plan areas
venues.enquiry_note: Enquiries can be made via the Functions enquiry form on the website, including event type and date.

weekly_specials.note: Also referred to as 'What's On'. Days run according to the venue's trading calendar.
weekly_specials.monday: Frites / Steak Frites - $25, 200g steak with fries
weekly_specials.thursday: Burger Thursday - $19 Double Dipped Burger (burger only)
weekly_specials.saturday: Taffy's Happy Hour 12pm-4pm, with live music till late
weekly_specials.sunday: Sunday Roast - Roast of the Day, pork and beef available
weekly_specials.exclusions: Weekly specials typically exclude public holidays

happy_hour.pricing: $8 schooners, $21 per jug (beer on tap, ask bar for current tap list)

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Thursday to Saturday: 10am to 3am. Sunday to Wednesday: 10am to 12am (midnight). Bottle Shop: 10am to 11:45pm (9:45pm on Sunday).

faqs.question: Where are you?
faqs.answer: 170 Caroline Chisholm Drive, Winston Hills NSW 2153.

faqs.question: Is there parking?
faqs.answer: Yes, free on-site parking in front of the venue.

faqs.question: Can I catch public transport?
faqs.answer: The bus stops within a short walk. The closest train stations are Parramatta and Seven Hills, both about 10 minutes away by car.

faqs.question: Do I need to book?
faqs.answer: To avoid disappointment, yes. For Friday and Saturday nights, definitely yes, as the venue books out. Otherwise, walk in and staff will happily find you a table.

faqs.question: Can I book for a big group?
faqs.answer: Groups of 20 or more should enquire via the Functions form so the room can be set up properly. Otherwise, you can book normally.

faqs.question: What's your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Table bookings can be cancelled up to 2 hours in advance via the confirmation email.

amenities_and_policies.wheelchair_accessible: Not stated on website - confirm directly with venue

data_notes.source: Extracted from thewinston.com.au on 2026-08-17 (homepage, contact, menus, CALA Bistro, Taffy's Sports Bar, Functions, and FAQ pages, plus current Winter 2026 CALA and Taffy's PDF menus).
known_gaps: Exact single-dish prices are given as category ranges rather than per-item, because the PDF menu text extraction does not reliably line up numbers with dish names - verify an exact price by phone (02 9624 4500) if a customer needs precision.
Wine and cocktail glass/bottle prices were present in the source PDF but likewise not reliably attributable per item.

'What's On' weekly graphics (social posts) were referenced on the homepage but specific event details for a given week are not captured here - check the What's On page or social media for the current week.
Live sports schedule is served via an embedded third-party widget and is not capturable as static text; direct customers to https://thewinston.com.au/taffys-sports-bar/#schedule for what's playing.
